audit.scope: raw collected files in C:/Users/Mohammed856/finengine-raw-odd (read-only); no network, no data/**, no AWS/Supabase; SHA-256 recomputed for every document listed (79 files in inventory)
audit.method: The English statement filings for FY2022-FY2025 and every interim from Q1 2022 to H1 2026 (18 filings) were read: image-only statement pages rendered and read by eye (FY2022, FY2023, FY2024, 9M 2022, H1 2022, Q1 2022, H1 2024, 9M 2024, Q1 2025, H1 2025, 9M 2025, 9M 2023, H1 2026), born-digital pages read from the text layer (FY2025, Q1 2023, H1 2023, Q1 2024, Q1 2026; not independently rendered). Cover pages of selected Arabic and FY2021 files were read to classify them. Arabic duplicates were not compared. All files from 2011 to 2021 (about 40) were NOT read. tools/check_transcripts.py (BS identity, cash-flow sum and roll, gross profit, NI split, quarter sums, declared cross-filing differences) passes for transcripts/4031.json.

value_correctness.summary: SAR thousand. Balance sheet, income statement and cash flow transcribed for FY2022-FY2025, Q1/H1/9M 2022-2025, Q1 2026 and H1 2026 with comparatives (FY2021, 2021 interims, 2022-2024 interims). All identities and the 18 quarter-sum chains pass. Loss in 2021-2022 (FY2021 -254,410; FY2022 -244,488), profit FY2023 211,477, FY2024 327,034, FY2025 404,709, H1 2026 3,875 (Q2 2026 loss -56,577). Re-presentations declared with BOTH values (24 pairs in transcripts/4031.json): (1) 2022 interims as first printed versus as re-presented in the 2023 comparatives: Q1 2022 cost of revenue 377,234 vs 381,072 (gross profit 47,564 vs 43,726, operating loss -20,282 vs -21,424), CFO 73,114 vs 52,614; H1 2022 gross profit 99,690 vs 92,765, CFO 130,195 vs 111,018; 9M 2022 gross profit 147,192 vs 136,741, CFO 28,896 vs 8,522 (net loss unchanged at -19,014, -85,864, -136,715); (2) Dec-2021 property and equipment 528,198 (2022 interims) vs 470,913 (FY2022 filing), total assets unchanged; (3) FY2024 operating profit 318,626 vs 314,244 (FY2025 filing), Q1 2025 97,067 vs 95,801, H1 2025 194,175 vs 192,464 (2026 filings: other income and finance lines moved; profit before zakat unchanged). Net profit, revenue, total assets and equity never differ between a filing and the later filing that repeats the period. FY2023 balance-sheet cash 79,090 includes restricted cash 453 (cash-flow closing cash 78,637). No NCI line; no discontinued operations; no share-count change in the period.

document_completeness.summary: All 18 English filings read hold balance sheet, income statement, OCI, equity and cash flow statements. Inventory errors: FY2022, FY2023, FY2024 (aa1b6af8, 9a603b1d, f5cdea4f) carry the publication-year label and have image-only statement pages (inventory saw income only from note pages), H1 2024 classed other_no_statements_found, H1 2025 and H1 2026 classed partial, and 9M 2024, Q1 2025, 9M 2025 are counted complete although cash flow was not detected on image pages. The Arabic FY2022 file (3ac894d8) is labelled 2022|FY (correct period) while its English counterpart is labelled 2023|FY, so the same fiscal year appears under two different labels and the English FY2022 file is the one that creates a false internal gap. Most periods exist in both English and Arabic. 2022 interims are in the folder as English and Arabic files whose text layers are garbled OCR (values must be read from images). Not assessed for 2011-2021.
